description: Screen a person or company name against the OFAC SDN and UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists: fuzzy matching with similarity scores, matched programs, entity type and country. Lists refreshed daily from official sources; screening runs locally — deterministic and fast. A match requires human review; not legal advice. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).
